description: We are students passionate about space, AI, robotics and software. We aim to solve real-world challenges through creativity and teamwork. We welcome members interested in Python, C++, AI/ML, web development, UI/UX, data science, astronomy, GIS and satellite data. Beginners welcome! We value fresh ideas, dedication and teamwork. Join us to explore NASA data and build something impactful. 🚀
summary:
MARSWALK is an interactive web-based Mars exploration platform designed to make planetary science more accessible and engaging. It brings multiple exploration tools together in one workspace, allowing users to explore the Martian surface, understand scientific discoveries, and plan virtual routes across the Red Planet.

The platform includes an interactive Mars Explorer for viewing surface maps, terrain and elevation layers; a Route Planner for exploring locations and planning paths; and a Science Discoveries section highlighting important findings from Mars missions. It also features an environmental monitoring interface designed to present observations such as temperature, wind speed, atmospheric pressure and radiation as relevant mission data becomes available.

MARSWALK aims to transform the way students, researchers and space enthusiasts interact with Mars by combining planetary mapping, scientific information and exploration tools in a single platform. Its modular design also allows future integration of additional NASA datasets, mission observations and AI-assisted capabilities, creating opportunities for deeper and more intelligent exploration of Mars.
details:
MARSWALK is an interactive, web-based Mars exploration platform that brings planetary mapping, route planning, scientific discoveries and environmental information into one workspace.

It includes Mars Explorer for exploring Martian locations and terrain, Route Planner for planning virtual routes, Science Discoveries for learning about mission findings, and Environmental Monitoring for viewing parameters such as temperature, wind, pressure and radiation.

The platform aims to make planetary science more accessible, support space education and encourage curiosity about Mars. Its unified interface provides an engaging exploration experience for students and space enthusiasts.

MARSWALK is designed with scalability and future expansion in mind, allowing integration of additional NASA datasets, mission observations and AI-assisted features.

Technologies used: Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, FastAPI, Docker, Vercel, Git and Render.

Our team focused on usability, accessibility, reliable scientific information, modular architecture and technical feasibility to create an expandable Mars exploration platform.
